books.title: The Hidden Forest
books.author: Jeannie Baker
books.description: A magical journey through a mysterious forest filled with secrets and adventure.

books.title: Mastering The Art Of Javascript

books.description: A practical guide to mastering modern JavaScript for web development.
books.story: From fundamentals to advanced patterns, this book teaches modern JavaScript with real-world projects, covering ES6+, APIs, async programming, and scalable architecture.

books.author: A.G. Riddle
books.description: A thrilling time-travel story filled with adventure.

books.title: AI Revolution
books.author: Erik Seversen
books.description: Learn how AI is changing the world.
books.story: A deep dive into artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, and the ethical future of intelligent systems.

books.title: The Science of Oceans
books.author: DK
books.description: Discover marine ecosystems and ocean mysteries.
